units.source_text: 三个人再次一起乘上矿车，矿车在海的左岸迅速下滑，间或从杂树林的枝叶下钻过。

en.t: The three of them got into the mine cart together again, and it slid quickly down along the left bank by the sea, sometimes passing under the branches and leaves of the thicket.

units.source_text: 但是，良平这个时候已经没有刚才那种兴致盎然的心情了。

en.t: But by then Ryohei no longer felt the excitement he had had a little earlier.

units.source_text: “矿车现在掉头回去才更好。”——良平心里默默祈祷起来。

en.t: It would be better if the mine cart turned around and went back now, Ryohei silently began to pray in his heart.

units.source_text: 当然，他自己也很明白，如果不能到达目的地，不管是矿车还是人，都回不去。

en.t: Of course, he himself understood very well that unless they reached their destination, neither the mine cart nor the people could go back.
